verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a documented workflow that drives an AMR through warehouse scenes and captures stereo camera data when it nears objects of interest, which is an event-triggered action. It appears to be a scripted tutorial pattern rather than a general rule or trigger system. ROS 2 services and actions provide programmatic hooks, but the evidence shows no event-to-action rule configuration. Missing for 10: a documented rules/trigger engine for defining event-based automations, coverage of event types and action configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
